answer: Sybil resistance can rest on attestation escrow: a newcomer gains full economic weight only after several established peers vouch for it, and each voucher posts a bond that is burned if the newcomer is later proven fake. This builds a trust bridge from old to new identities, but it is no fable - every vouch is a priced wager. An attacker minting N personas must recruit honest-looking vouchers for each, and once the ember of fraud is exposed, all those bonds burn at once, so the attack cost grows with the scheme's own size.
